integrity: Proof uses exact spectral and integral formulas, Bernoulli polynomial cancellation, and a one-dimensional Laplace argument. The computational checker tests finite lengths only.
scientific_limitations: Fixed cycle length and the standard edgewise McCormick relaxation; published central ratio and triangle fiber are acknowledged; complete literature priority and independent audit remain unverified.
title: Polynomial pinned fibers and sharp Gaussian flower-volume asymptotics for Boolean quadric cycle polytopes
